meta.title: Oh-My-BBFF Team
meta.description: Role-based organization of subagents and Team members: role catalog, orchestrator/leader doctrine, per-role tool/skill/MCP scope and model routes.

ui.modeLeader: Team service available (session mode is shown on its card)
ui.modeOrchestrator: No Team service observed this run
ui.superagentPresent: Public orchestration service observed (identity explained below)
ui.saved: Saved; applies to new dispatches and the next request
ui.hint: Global roles; workspace overlays stay read-only. Saves and reverts share the audited change history.
ui.notLive: Root not loaded; the switch applies when it wakes
ui.noDispatch: No role-bound agents in this session yet
ui.reuse_fresh: New agent for every new object/task
ui.reuse_amend_same: Continue the original agent for task corrections
ui.reuse_pool: Prefer idle agents with the same role
ui.reuseHint_fresh: Start a new agent for every new object/task (useful for reviews; avoids context carry-over).
ui.reuseHint_amend_same: For corrections to the same task, continue the original agent via steer/message; do not start another.
ui.reuseHint_pool: Prefer an existing idle member or child with the same role; start a new agent only when none is idle.
ui.defaultModelHint: An empty list uses the current DSH default. Configured tiers form a whitelist; models never switch automatically.
ui.concurrencyHint: Per role during this module lifetime; reload/restart resets the count. Does not cap members or continuations. Blank adds no limit.
ui.delegationRoles: Delegation role IDs (comma-separated; blank means unrestricted)
ui.requiredFields: A summary and an identity prompt are required.
ui.invalidId: Use 2–32 lowercase letters, digits or hyphens, starting with a letter.
ui.tierIncomplete: Every tier requires a provider, model and use condition.
ui.badConcurrency: Concurrency must be a positive integer or blank.
ui.capHint: Limits BBFF hiring only; never edits DSH or the profile. Only core members count; outsourced agents do not.
ui.unknownCap: DSH 0.2.2 has no member-count cap (live members are limited by the native maxActiveSubagents setting, which plugins cannot read); only the BBFF soft cap applies.
ui.superagentYield: When a public orchestration service is observed
ui.invalidSettings: Check integer ranges: helpers ≥0; soft cap 1..DSH cap or blank.
ui.revertWarning: Restore the global files from before this change. Later changes to the same files are also reverted; current files are snapshotted first.
ui.reverted: Reverted and recorded as a new change
ui.modelsUnavailable: Model listing is unavailable; existing tiers are preserved.
ui.apiFailed: Save failed; your draft is retained.
ui.namingHint_function: Name members after their long-lived function, not the current task.
ui.namingHint_seat: Use seat-1, seat-2…; the real function lives in the binding and can change with a formation.
ui.formationsEmpty: No formations yet. Define standing seats and functions; the Lead decides how to staff them.
ui.formationRepair: The global formations file has structural errors; saves and removals are unavailable. Restore it through change history or explicitly repair the configuration first.
ui.formationHint: Saves definitions only. A Lead session applies formations with bbff_team_formation; this page never hires members.
ui.activeUnavailable: Session information is unavailable; global formation editing still works.
ui.emptySeats: An empty formation can be saved; it does not assign or hire anyone.
ui.helperHint: Helpers may serve only another main seat in this formation. Applying helper seats requires helpers mode.
ui.runtimeWarning: These diagnostics do not block saving a definition, but must be resolved before applying it:
ui.badFormationId: Use lowercase letters, digits and single hyphen-separated segments, starting with a letter.
ui.badFormationLabel: A formation label is required (up to 120 characters).
ui.badSeatName: Start with a lowercase letter, use single hyphen-separated segments, at most 48 characters, and not lead.
ui.staleFormation: Another caller changed this formation. Cancel, refresh and try again.
ui.diagnosticsTier: Role has no tier with this label
ui.diagnosticsAssist: Helper target must be another main seat in this formation
ui.diagnosticsQuota: Helper count exceeds the per-main limit
ui.diagnosticsCap: Seat count exceeds the current member cap
ui.discardStage: Discard stage and return to editing
ui.removeFormationWarning: Removes the definition only, not members or existing bindings. History can restore the whole before-file snapshot.
ui.formationWholeDefinition: Replaces this whole formation definition without applying it or changing member bindings. If it is already active, the Lead reads the new definition on its next request.
ui.singleTierHint: Only one model tier is configured; dispatch never switches automatically. Add another tier below to offer an explicit alternative.
ui.customNoDefault: Custom role: no shipped role default
ui.allowList: Listed names only (an empty list allows none)
ui.manualNames: Enter names separated by commas or newlines. Catalog status does not grant permission.
ui.catalogCapability: Shared catalog unavailable; valid manual names can be retained or entered without installation diagnosis.
ui.badFilter: Filter names violate host syntax or contain duplicates.
ui.viewCurrentWorkspace: View the current session root workspace
ui.workspaceReadOnly: Read-only composition: shipped → global → workspace. Edit global roles above; this view never writes workspace files.
ui.workspaceIncomplete: Composition has diagnostics; only readable valid layers are shown.
ui.cumulativeHint: Persisted bindings include completed dispatches; reassignment and retention can change these counts.
ui.overrideHint: A manual selection takes priority over role tiers; role model edits do not replace it.
ui.unknownEffectsHint: Catalog/contract effect status is not role entitlement. Reasons and the read-only policy are shown below.
ui.unknownEffectReason: No current owner effect declaration or verified adapter class is available.
ui.staleSettings: Another caller changed a related setting. The draft is retained; refresh and compare before editing again.
ui.doctrineHint: Changes instruction text only, not tool permission, depth, member or native limits. The session card shows actual injection state.
ui.doctrinePreview: Example-context preview (does not change actual injection)
ui.invalidAdvanced: Use the ranges shown for each setting.
ui.staleRole: Another caller changed this role. Retain the draft, refresh and compare before editing again.
ui.preflightWarnings: Model availability warnings (saving is allowed; dispatch still requires preflight)
ui.contextEnglish: English by default; you may write in any language.
ui.nativeBlacklistHint: Automatic capability restrictions cover DSH/BBFF native tools only; explicit names may restrict external tools.
ui.currentDoctrineHint: Read-only computation of the Team section for the next assembly; not a historical request receipt.
ui.presetRequirement: Team supports only the standard and cordis (Creator) presets; PTC, minimal and other presets will not work properly.

ui.setting.nestingMode.effect: Choose member delegation or Lead-assigned helpers; no members are created or interrupted automatically.
ui.setting.memberCap.effect: Limit how many core members the Lead may hire; blank means no cap. DSH 0.2.2 has no member-count cap; live members are bounded by the native maxActiveSubagents.
ui.setting.memberNaming.effect: Only affects newly hired members; existing native member identities cannot be renamed.
ui.setting.helpersPerMember.effect: Limit helpers per main member without removing existing helpers.
ui.setting.superagentYield.effect: Yield only foreign-owned sessions or all sessions while another orchestrator is present.
ui.setting.maxDepth.effect: Bound nested delegation; the native DSH depth remains the ceiling.
ui.setting.unknownToolEffect.effect: Choose how read-only roles handle unknown native effects; external tools remain user-owned.
ui.setting.cardRefreshMs.effect: Lower values refresh the card and read state more often.
ui.setting.pendingRefreshMs.effect: Lower values retry pending reads sooner and more often.
ui.setting.rosterWaitMs.effect: Wait only for an existing shared refresh; return immediately when none is in flight.
ui.setting.rosterOutsourcedLimit.effect: Outsourced agents (dispatched and unbound subagents) get one line each; beyond this number they are only counted.
ui.setting.historyInitialLimit.effect: Choose the initial visible configuration-history count without deleting records.
ui.setting.historyPageSize.effect: Choose how many more history entries each expansion loads.
ui.setting.reportExcerptChars.effect: Bound retained report excerpts; shorter values reduce preview text.
ui.setting.reportCacheEntries.effect: Retain report reads for more sessions at a higher memory cost.
ui.setting.activityDefaultLimit.effect: Choose the default recent-activity event count returned to the Lead.
ui.setting.activityMaxLimit.effect: Cap activity events per query without changing source records.
ui.setting.activityPreviewChars.effect: Bound field previews while retaining original lengths and truncation markers.
ui.setting.modelCacheMs.effect: Reuse model listings longer; newly available models may appear later.
ui.setting.bindingLimit.effect: Evict oldest eligible bindings while protecting members and active work.
ui.setting.sessionModeLimit.effect: Bound retained session modes while protecting active root sessions.
ui.setting.doctrineTemplates.effect: Change instructions without relaxing real tool permissions.
ui.setting.displayLabels.effect: Replace displayed names without changing fields or behavior.
ui.setting.roles.effect: Edit Leader-facing briefs, member identities and permissions separately; the caller still chooses a listed model.
ui.setting.doctrineRules.effect: Adjust dispatch, verification and reporting rules without changing mechanical permissions.
ui.setting.doctrineFragments.effect: Edit condition-dependent instructions and preview an example first.
ui.setting.doctrinePositions.effect: Edit complete prompts for the four organization positions; a bad edit affects the whole instruction block.
ui.setting.formations.effect: Save reusable seat assignments; applying never hires or interrupts members.
ui.setting.workspaceRoles.effect: Inspect effective workspace roles without rewriting project configuration.
ui.setting.permissionLayers.effect: Inspect other permission layers; role policy cannot bypass them.
ui.setting.history.effect: Inspect or revert reviewed changes; reverts still validate current bytes.

ui.doctrine.sharedRules.title: Dispatch and verification
ui.doctrine.sharedRules.trigger: When the root session has team guidance on
ui.doctrine.sharedRules.effect: Changes the shared rules: classify first, pick tiers explicitly, dispatch in parallel and verify reports.
ui.doctrine.orchestrator.title: Orchestrator position prompt
ui.doctrine.orchestrator.trigger: Without a team, or when orchestrator mode is chosen
ui.doctrine.orchestrator.effect: Replaces the whole orchestrator way of working; does not change actual permissions.
ui.doctrine.leader.title: Leader position prompt
ui.doctrine.leader.trigger: For a native team lead with leader mode on
ui.doctrine.leader.effect: Replaces the whole leader way of working; live member state is still read through tools.
ui.doctrine.member.title: Member position prompt
ui.doctrine.member.effect: Replaces the member way of working and where the role identity is injected.
ui.doctrine.child.title: Child position prompt
ui.doctrine.child.effect: Replaces the whole one-shot child way of working.
ui.doctrine.rootWithTeam.title: Note when a team exists
ui.doctrine.rootWithTeam.trigger: When a team exists but the root chose orchestrator mode
ui.doctrine.rootWithTeam.effect: Explains that this mode hires no members and uses one-shot roles instead.
ui.doctrine.rootWithoutTeam.title: Note without a team
ui.doctrine.rootWithoutTeam.trigger: When there is no native team
ui.doctrine.rootWithoutTeam.effect: Explains that the root owns the integration and final conclusions of one-shot roles.
ui.doctrine.nativeEscape.title: Native delegation fallback
ui.doctrine.nativeEscape.trigger: When the native subagent tool is still visible
ui.doctrine.nativeEscape.effect: Changes when to use native delegation; grants no tools.
ui.doctrine.namingFunction.title: Name by standing function
ui.doctrine.namingFunction.trigger: When member naming is by standing function
ui.doctrine.namingFunction.effect: Changes naming advice for new members; does not rename existing ones.
ui.doctrine.namingSeat.title: Name by seat
ui.doctrine.namingSeat.trigger: When member naming is by seat
ui.doctrine.namingSeat.effect: Changes naming advice for new seats; does not rename existing members.
ui.doctrine.leaderNested.title: Nested member work mode
ui.doctrine.leaderNested.trigger: When the member work mode is nested delegation
ui.doctrine.leaderNested.effect: Explains that members may delegate further; real depth is still decided by permissions and the native limit.
ui.doctrine.leaderHelpers.title: Main members and helpers mode
ui.doctrine.leaderHelpers.trigger: When the member work mode is helpers
ui.doctrine.leaderHelpers.effect: Explains helper ownership and limits; does not hire helpers automatically.
ui.doctrine.memberReporting.title: Collaboration and reporting
ui.doctrine.memberReporting.trigger: When the member is not a read-only role
ui.doctrine.memberReporting.effect: Changes task-board and messaging guidance; actual permissions are still enforced by the guard.
ui.doctrine.memberReadonlyReporting.title: Read-only reporting
ui.doctrine.memberReadonlyReporting.trigger: When the member is a read-only role
ui.doctrine.memberReadonlyReporting.effect: Reminds read-only roles to report in their reply and not to update the durable task board.
ui.doctrine.memberNested.title: Member delegation rules
ui.doctrine.memberNested.trigger: In nested mode while the depth limit is not reached
ui.doctrine.memberNested.effect: Changes advice on when members delegate; does not widen the roles they may dispatch.
ui.doctrine.memberDepthLimited.title: Depth limit note
ui.doctrine.memberDepthLimited.trigger: When the native or configured depth limit is reached
ui.doctrine.memberDepthLimited.effect: Explains why it cannot delegate further and points to doing the work or reporting to the Lead.
ui.doctrine.memberHelpers.title: Member helper rules
ui.doctrine.memberHelpers.effect: Reminds members to get helpers through the Lead instead of dispatching children themselves.
ui.doctrine.assignedHelpers.title: Assigned helpers
ui.doctrine.assignedHelpers.trigger: When the member already has assigned helpers
ui.doctrine.assignedHelpers.effect: Lists the helper names it may contact, without busy or idle state.
ui.doctrine.assist.title: Helper duty
ui.doctrine.assist.trigger: When the member has a designated main member
ui.doctrine.assist.effect: States whom to report to and forbids getting more helpers or dispatching.
ui.doctrine.memberRole.title: Role identity injection
ui.doctrine.memberRole.trigger: When the member has a BBFF role bound
ui.doctrine.memberRole.effect: Edits the identity injection, delegation and model-tier notes; editable, does not change ACLs.
ui.doctrine.memberUnbound.title: Unbound note
ui.doctrine.memberUnbound.trigger: When the member has no BBFF role yet
ui.doctrine.memberUnbound.effect: Reminds it to follow the task brief and not to dispatch on its own.
ui.doctrine.childReadOnly.title: Read-only task boundary
ui.doctrine.childReadOnly.trigger: When the child role is read-only
ui.doctrine.childReadOnly.effect: Reminds it not to change files or durable state; actual tools have separate hard limits.
ui.doctrine.childWritable.title: Writable task boundary
ui.doctrine.childWritable.trigger: When the child role may write
ui.doctrine.childWritable.effect: Reminds it not to widen the task scope; grants no extra write permission.
ui.doctrine.targets.title: Delegable roles
ui.doctrine.targets.trigger: When the role still has delegation targets
ui.doctrine.targets.effect: Lists the targets' leader briefs and model tiers without exposing their identity prompts.
